headline: Two teams move into ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: mikelou1 rose from 33rd to 13th at 66.39, while guoqin gu moved from 29th to 16th at 61.81. Both entered the gold places.
The cutoff now stands at 16th with 61.81 points. ARCward Intelligence is 17th at 58.33, just outside the medal places.
